spans.s: तिनाशक तिनाशक, अस्, m. a tree, = तिनिश.

तिनिश तिनिश, अस्, m. the tree Dalbergia
Ougeinensis; [cf. तिणिस and तिमिश.]

तिन्तिड तिन्तिड, अस्, m. the tamarind tree,
Tamarindus Indica; acid seasoning, sour sauce,
especially a sauce made of the fruit of the tamarind
tree; an inauspicious period, the evil aspect of
planets (?); (ई), f. the Indian tamarind tree; a sour
sauce, especially one made of the fruit of the tamarind
tree; Emblic Myrobalan.
—तिन्तिडी-द्यूत, अम्, n.
a kind of game, a sort of odd or even played with
tamarind seeds.

तिन्तिडीक, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. the tamarind tree;
(अम्), n. the fruit of the tamarind; a sour sauce,
especially one made of the fruit of the tamarind
tree.

तिन्तिली or तिन्तिलिका or तिन्तिलीका, f. the tamarind
tree.

तिन्दिश तिन्दिश, अस्, m. a kind of plant,
= टिण्डिश.

तिन्दु तिन्दु, उस्, m. a species of ebony,
from the fruit of which is obtained a kind of resin
used in India as pitch for caulking vessels &c.,
Diospyros Glutinosa; also Strychnos Nux Vomica.

तिन्दुक, अस्, m. the tree Diospyros Embryopteris
or Diospyros Glutinosa; (ई), f. the resinous fruit
of this tree; (अम्), n. the fruit of this tree; a
Karṣa, a kind of measure or weight (= the weight
of the Tinduka fruit).

तिन्दुकि, इस्, f. or तिन्दुल, अस्, m. the tree Dios-
pyros Embryopteris.
तिन्दुकिनी, f. the senna plant, = आवर्तकी.

तिन्दुविल्व तिन्दुविल्व, अम्, n., N. of the
birthplace of the Lyric poet Jaya-deva.
